pages.title: Redstone Singularity
pages.text: Redstone dust in such quantity that it collapsed into a single point. It glows a pulsing red and seems to carry a faint signal, as though waiting to switch something on. Its warmth fluctuates rhythmically.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted to know what redstone's strange conductivity would do under extreme pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed a mountain of dust into a single pulsing point.
